items.claim: Constrained delegation is exploitable without the user's TGT because the S4U2Proxy Kerberos extension lets a service ask the KDC for a service ticket on behalf of any client, so compromising a delegation-enabled service yields a ticket for a back-end service as an arbitrary user.
items.body:
Constrained delegation is exploitable without the user's TGT because the S4U2Proxy Kerberos extension lets a service ask the KDC for a service ticket on behalf of any client, so compromising a delegation-enabled service yields a ticket for a back-end service as an arbitrary user.

HackTricks reference: 143e37ea (notion:143e37ea-2f5c-4dd2-9c8e-e0d099207e1d)
items.disproof: The KDC refuses the S4U2Proxy TGS request because the service is not configured for constrained delegation to that target, or the resulting service ticket is not accepted by the back-end service.
